model_system: minimal 2D square-lattice altermagnet model with two magnetic sublattices (A/B) and anisotropic third-neighbor hopping; validated against MnF2

key_params.unit_cell: two magnetic ions A and B with opposite spin polarization
key_params.orbitals: single orbital per magnetic ion in minimal model
key_params.hoppings: nearest-neighbor t1, second-neighbor t2, third-neighbor t3
key_params.anisotropy: third-neighbor hopping split into t3+delta_t and t3-delta_t along alternating diagonal directions
key_params.exchange: local intra-atomic exchange field h_eff with opposite sign on A/B sublattices
essential_mechanism: alternating spin-polarized wavefunction localization on A/B sublattices
broken translational symmetry from alternating distortion of non-magnetic ion cages

headline_claim: The minimal exchange-plus-anisotropic-hopping model reproduces hallmark altermagnetic band features, including nodal spin degeneracies and large spin splittings, and is consistent with ab initio calculations for MnF2.
replication_difficulty: medium — model construction is simple but reproducing the published band topology requires inferring/reading the full Hamiltonian and parameter set from the main text/full paper.
